events.name: Chain Reaction: Chef Chel & Friends
events.info: Chain Reaction ft. Chef Chel & Friends Friday, December 18 10PM-2AM Pay what you can \ $10 Suggested Come Spark Something! Chef Chel is serving up more than just flavor---she's dishing out beats that make you move inside and out. Hailing from St. Louis, Missouri, this dancefloor chef blends house, funk, and feel-good grooves into a recipe that always keeps the crowd cookin'. With a warm heart, mom-energy, and a killer ear for rhythm, Chel knows how to stir the soul and spice up any room. Whether it's a sweaty underground set or a sunny open-air party, she brings the heat---and she's always got something sizzling in the sonic kitchen. Expect heavy bass, high vibes, and a whole lot of flavor.

events.name: Colt Ball & The Git Down
events.info: Colt Ball & The Git Down Saturday, December 19 10PM-2AM Pay What you can \ $10 Suggested Formed in 2023 out of St. Louis MO comes a sound of its own. Blending styles of Reggae, Folk, Jam, Funk, Improv, Fusion, and Hip Hop; Colt Ball & the Git Down will make you do exactly that. GIT DOWN! The lyrics are intentional, the melodies upbeat, and the jams are DEEP! Moving air with their audience is the mission and Feel Good Music is the repetition. They pull from each other just as much as the crowd with a conversation of sound and color. You may have caught them at SummerCamp Music Festival (IL), Hillberry (AR), Alternating Currents (IA), or ReKinection (MO). You may have even seen them opening for The Wailers, Here Come the Mummies, Sunsquabi, or even working with Cas Haley! Now's your chance to catch them live and direct in St. Louis MO!
